text:
emily yan: Heads-up: Marketplace listing freeze checklist — AWS/Azure/GCP require different metadata fields and lead times. Need to align on content freeze, localized copy, and SI onboarding steps.

dylan reyes: Good call. Can we lock English copy by EOD tomorrow and localization (es/fr/de/ja) by next Wed? Each cloud marketplace has a 48h review window.

maria chen: Legal needs the joint announcement copy 24h before embargo. Proposed embargo window: Thurs 07:00 PT for APAC-friendly timing, public post Thurs 13:00 PT. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

emily yan: Works for me if localization team can turn around tokens by Tue. Also need confirmation from hardware partners on co-brand logos (SVG, 1x/2x) and approved quote snippets.

samir patel: EdgeAccel and RackX confirmed badge assets and a short quote (1-2 lines) from their CTOs. I'll upload to /shared/partners/hw-assets by 3pm today and tag assets with marketplace-specific filenames (aws_logo.svg, azure_logo.svg, gcp_logo.svg).

dylan reyes: For marketplace metadata, we need: long description (300-600 chars), 3 bullet highlights, pricing tier mapping, SLA snippet, and a partner contact email. I'll draft the mapping and post a PR to the content repo.

maria chen: Press ops: can we run two parallel embargo lists? One for press-only (early brief) and one for general partner comms? If so, legal will need separate signoffs.

emily yan: Yes, split is helpful. Press-only brief goes to selected outlets 12h before general partner comms. Add a dry run for the announcement flow (publish -> marketplace sync -> landing page redirect) tomorrow 9am PT.

press-ops-bot: dry-run-scheduler: dry run scheduled: 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. Participants: emily yan, dylan reyes, samir patel, press ops, SI lead.

samir patel: SI team note: tenant provisioning template and SSO mapping are the biggest time sinks. I'll provide a sample terraform snippet and SAML attribute map. Posting to the runbook shortly.

dylan reyes: Also flagging analytics: we need UTM templates for co-marketing links and a consistent CTA id for A/B tests on the landing page. Ping growth for tracking.

emily yan: Action items summary:

```
- Lock English copy: emily/dylan -> EOD tomorrow
- Localizations (es/fr/de/ja): localization team -> next Wed
- Upload partner assets: samir -> today 3pm (/shared/partners/hw-assets)
- Legal signoff on press & partner briefs: maria -> 24h before embargo
- SI runbook + terraform sample: samir -> today 5pm
- Dry run: press-ops-bot -> 2026-05-06 09:00 PT
- UTM/CTA mapping: dylan -> ping growth
```

maria chen: I'll schedule the legal review block and add the two separate signoff forms. If anyone hits a blocker, call me immediately. :hammer_and_wrench:
